paper_title: Direct limits for scalar field dark matter from a gravitational-wave detector
suggested_experiment_name: GEO 600 scalar field dark matter search
coupling_convention: Lambda_i^-1 (inverse coupling scale) in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis (combined Lambda_e^-1 and Lambda_gamma^-1 'This work' green region)
notes: GEO600 gravitational-wave detector direct search for scalar field DM coupling to the beamsplitter. Constraints set on both photon coupling Lambda_gamma (fine-structure/alpha variation -> ScalarPhoton) and electron coupling Lambda_e (electron-mass variation -> ScalarElectron), reported equally, so coupling type is ambiguous. y-axis is Lambda_i^-1 in GeV^-1, best (lower) limit ~1/(3e19 GeV)=3.3e-20 GeV^-1 for masses ~1e-13 to 1e-11 eV (Basic Scalar scenario, rho=0.4 GeV/cm^3). Only the best-limit value is extracted from text as an approximate horizontal band; the full mass-dependent curve spans ~2e-13 to 2.5e-11 eV (50 Hz-6 kHz) but is not numerically tabulated.
